private static final class Interval {
  static final Interval TOP = new Interval(null,null);
  final BigInteger lo, hi;
  private Interval(BigInteger lo, BigInteger hi) { this.lo=lo; this.hi=hi; }
  static Interval fromClosed(BigInteger lo, BigInteger hi) { if (lo != null && hi != null && lo.compareTo(hi) > 0) return null; return new Interval(lo,hi); }
  boolean isTop() { return lo==null && hi==null; }
  boolean isSingleton(BigInteger v) { return lo!=null && hi!=null && lo.equals(v) && hi.equals(v); }

private State withVar(String name, Value v) {
  if (bottom) return this;
  if (v.isBottom()) return bottom();
  if (v.isTop()) {
    if (!vars.containsKey(name)) return this;
    Map<String, Value> m = new HashMap<>(vars);
    m.remove(name);

  }

  m.put(name, v);

}

private State intersect(State other) {
  if (bottom || other.bottom) return bottom();
  Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
  keys.addAll(vars.keySet()); keys.addAll(other.vars.keySet());
  Map<String, Value> m = new HashMap<>();
  for (String k : keys) {
    Value a = vars.getOrDefault(k, Value.top());
    Value b = other.vars.getOrDefault(k, Value.top());
    Value v = a.intersect(b);
    if (v.isBottom()) return bottom();
    if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k, v);
  }
  return new State(false, m);
}

State.join:
private State join(State other) {
  if (bottom) return other;
  if (other.bottom) return this;
  if (isTop() || other.isTop()) return top();
  Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>(); ...
  Map<String, Value> m = new HashMap<>();
  for (String k : keys) {
    Value a = vars.get(k);
    Value b = other.vars.get(k);
    if (a == null || b == null) continue;
    Value v = a.join(b);
    if (v.isBottom()) return bottom(); // shouldn't
    if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k, v);
  }
  return new State(false, m);
}

private boolean entails(State other) {
  if (bottom) return true;
  if (other.bottom) return false;
  Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>(); ...
  for (String k : keys) {
    Value a = vars.get(k);
    Value b = other.vars.get(k);
    if (a == null && b != null) return false;
    if (a != null && b == null) continue;
    if (!a.entails(b)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

private State applySquareConstraint(State state, String var, BigInteger c, BinOp op) {
  if (state.isBottom()) return bottom();
  if (op == BinOp.Eq) {
    if (c.signum() < 0) return bottom();
    BigInteger s = c.sqrt();
    if (!s.multiply(s).equals(c)) return bottom();
    if (s.signum() == 0) {
      Value nv = state.valueOf(var).intersect(Value.singleton(ZERO));
      return nv.isBottom()? bottom : state.withVar(var,nv);
    }
    Value allowed = Value.fromIntervals(List.of(Interval.fromClosed(s.negate(), s.negate()), Interval.fromClosed(s, s)));
    Value nv = state.valueOf(var).intersect(allowed);
    return nv.isBottom()? bottom : state.withVar(var,nv);
  } else { // Ne

public static final class State {
  private final boolean bottom;
  private final Map<String, Value> vars;
  private State(boolean bottom, Map<String, Value> vars) { this.bottom=bottom; this.vars=Map.copyOf(vars); }
  static State top() { return new State(false, Map.of()); }
  static State bottom() { return new State(true, Map.of()); }
  boolean isBottom() { return bottom; }
  boolean isTop() { return !bottom && vars.isEmpty(); }
  Value valueOf(String name) { return vars.getOrDefault(name, Value.top()); }
  State withVar(String name, Value v) { if (bottom) return this; if (v.isBottom()) return bottom(); if (v.isTop()) { if (!vars.containsKey(name)) return this; Map<String,Value> m=new HashMap<>(vars); m.remove(name); return new State(false,m);} Map<String,Value> m=new HashMap<>(vars); m.put(name,v); return new State(false,m); }
  State intersect(State other) { if (bottom || other.bottom) return bottom(); Map<String,Value> m=new HashMap<>(); Set<String> keys=new HashSet<>(); keys.addAll(vars.keySet()); keys.addAll(other.vars.keySet()); for (String k: keys) { Value a=vars.getOrDefault(k, Value.top()); Value b=other.vars.getOrDefault(k, Value.top()); Value v=a.intersect(b); if (v.isBottom()) return bottom(); if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k,v); } return new State(false,m); }
  State join(State other) { if (bottom) return other; if (other.bottom) return this; if (isTop() || other.isTop()) return top(); Map<String,Value> m=new HashMap<>(); Set<String> keys=new HashSet<>(); keys.addAll(vars.keySet()); keys.addAll(other.vars.keySet()); for (String k: keys) { Value a=vars.get(k); Value b=other.vars.get(k); if (a==null || b==null) { // one top for var -> join top, omit
          continue;
       }
       Value v=a.join(b); if (v.isBottom()) return bottom(); // shouldn't
       if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k,v);
     }
     return new State(false,m);
  }
  State widen(State other) { // similar to join but use widen; if one top for var omit
     if (bottom) return other; if (other.bottom) return this; if (isTop() || other.isTop()) return top(); Map... for keys: if a==null||b==null continue; Value v=a.widen(b); if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k,v); return new State(false,m);
  }
  boolean entails(State other) { if (bottom) return true; if (other.bottom) return false; Set<String> keys=new HashSet<>(); keys.addAll(vars.keySet()); keys.addAll(other.vars.keySet()); for (String k: keys) { Value a=vars.get(k); Value b=other.vars.get(k); if (a==null && b!=null) return false; if (a!=null && b==null) continue; if (!a.entails(b)) return false; } return true; }

private State withVar(String name, Value v) {
  if (bottom) return this;
  if (v.isBottom()) return bottom();
  if (v.isTop()) {
    if (!vars.containsKey(name)) return this;
    Map<String, Value> m = new HashMap<>(vars);
    m.remove(name);
    return new State(false, m);
  }

  m.put(name, v);
  return new State(false, m);
}

private State intersect(State other) {
  if (bottom || other.bottom) return bottom();
  Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
  keys.addAll(vars.keySet()); keys.addAll(other.vars.keySet());
  Map<String, Value> m = new HashMap<>();
  for (String k : keys) {
    Value a = vars.getOrDefault(k, Value.top());
    Value b = other.vars.getOrDefault(k, Value.top());
    Value v = a.intersect(b);
    if (v.isBottom()) return bottom();
    if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k, v);
  }
  return new State(false, m);
}

State.join:
private State join(State other) {
  if (bottom) return other;
  if (other.bottom) return this;
  if (isTop() || other.isTop()) return top();
  Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>(); ...
  Map<String, Value> m = new HashMap<>();
  for (String k : keys) {
    Value a = vars.get(k);
    Value b = other.vars.get(k);
    if (a == null || b == null) continue;
    Value v = a.join(b);
    if (v.isBottom()) return bottom(); // shouldn't
    if (!v.isTop()) m.put(k, v);
  }
  return new State(false, m);
}

private boolean entails(State other) {
  if (bottom) return true;
  if (other.bottom) return false;
  Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>(); ...
  for (String k : keys) {
    Value a = vars.get(k);
    Value b = other.vars.get(k);
    if (a == null && b != null) return false;
    if (a != null && b == null) continue;
    if (!a.entails(b)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

applySquareConstraint:
private State applySquareConstraint(State state, String var, BigInteger c, BinOp op) {
  if (state.isBottom()) return bottom();
  if (op == BinOp.Eq) {
    if (c.signum() < 0) return bottom();
    BigInteger s = c.sqrt();
    if (!s.multiply(s).equals(c)) return bottom();
    if (s.signum() == 0) {
      Value nv = state.valueOf(var).intersect(Value.singleton(ZERO));
      return nv.isBottom()? bottom : state.withVar(var,nv);
    }
    Value allowed = Value.fromIntervals(List.of(Interval.fromClosed(s.negate(), s.negate()), Interval.fromClosed(s, s)));
    Value nv = state.valueOf(var).intersect(allowed);
    return nv.isBottom()? bottom : state.withVar(var,nv);
  } else { // Ne
    if (c.signum() < 0) return state;
    BigInteger s = c.sqrt();
    if (!s.multiply(s).equals(c)) return state;
    Value nv = state.valueOf(var);
    if (s.signum() == 0) nv = nv.excludePoint(ZERO);
    else {
      nv = nv.excludePoint(s.negate());
      if (!nv.isBottom()) nv = nv.excludePoint(s);
    }
    return nv.isBottom()? bottom : state.withVar(var,nv);
  }
}

Value widen(Value other) {
  if (isTop() || other.isTop()) return top();
  if (isBottom()) return other;
  if (other.isBottom()) return this;
  Value j = join(other);
  Interval ha = hull();
  Interval hb = other.hull();
  if (ha != null && hb != null) {
    boolean loMoved = ha.lo != null && (hb.lo == null || hb.lo.compareTo(ha.lo) < 0);
    boolean hiMoved = ha.hi != null && (hb.hi == null || hb.hi.compareTo(ha.hi) > 0);
    if (loMoved || hiMoved) {
      BigInteger newLo = (loMoved || ha.lo == null || hb.lo == null) ? null : ha.lo;
      BigInteger newHi = (hiMoved || ha.hi == null || hb.hi == null) ? null : ha.hi;
      Interval hw = Interval.fromClosed(newLo, newHi);
      if (hw != null) return Value.fromIntervals(List.of(hw));
    }
  }
  return j;
}
